object.value: AMR-07 starts pallet pick in aisle A
Cell restarted after the break; PALLET_C3 started from the HMI
Technician clears the aisle and resets AMR-07
Cell supervisor notified; cell locked out
AMR-07 PSTOP: fork contact, rack upright 14B
PF-3 locating edge found bent; part 7731-B dropped
AMR-07 WARN: protective field interrupted in PICK-A
Technician clears the aisle and resets
AMR-07 PSTOP: fork contact, rack upright 14B
Fork contacts rack upright; protective stop
AMR-07 WARN: protective field interrupted in PICK-A

During the pick at P1 the gripper fingers struck the locating edge of infeed fixture PF-3. Collision detection stopped the arm and the operator pressed the E-stop at OP-2. The part fell onto the floor guard. Nobody was inside the cell.
Collision detection on joint 5 at pick P1; protective stop
Operator presses the E-stop at OP-2
Fleet manager flags AMR-07 as blocked
